title: Maximum excess over uniformity
statement: Let $V$ be a finite nonempty set and let $p:V\to\mathbb{Q}$. The uniform excess of $p$ is the maximum, over $i\in V$, of $p(i)-1/|V|$.
hypotheses_covered: p maps V to the rational numbers
